import java.util.Scanner;


public class TwoProblems {

	/**
	 * @param args
	 */
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		Scanner input = new Scanner(System.in);
		int x = input.nextInt();
		int t = input.nextInt();
		int a = input.nextInt();
		int b = input.nextInt();
		int da = input.nextInt();
		int db = input.nextInt();
	  int total1 = a;
	  int total2 = b;
		for(int i=0; i<t;i++){
	        //	System.out.println(total1 + " " + total2);
	        	for(int j=0; j<t;j++){
	        		if(total1+total2==x){
	        			System.out.println("YES");
	        			return;
	        		}
	        		if(total1+total2 < x)break;
	        		total2-=db;
	        		//System.out.println(total1 + " " + total2);
	        	}
	        	total2 = b;
	        	total1 -=da;
	        	if(total1+total2<x)break;
		}
		 total1 = a;
		 total2=b;
		for(int i=0; i<t;i++){
			if(total1==x){
				System.out.println("YES");
				return;
			}
			if(total1<x)break;
		  total1-=da;
		}
		for(int i=0; i<t;i++){
			if(total2==x){
				System.out.println("YES");
				return ;
			}
			if(total2<x)break;
			total2-=db;
		}
		if(x!=0)System.out.println("NO");
		else
			System.out.println("YES");
	}
	

}
